page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-8-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this server features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 63 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is supported by a local 68 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core capabilities. The instance achieves top-tier performance in single-core stress-ng tests and single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3 decompression. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and Passmark database operations fall within the average tier. Redis SET operations reach 14.96 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput is measured at 27.24 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highmem-8-lssd offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside dedicated CPU resources and fast local NVMe storage, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive multi-core scaling. The hardware profile is well-suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, moderate data processing pipelines, and web serving applications requiring local scratch space.
